report.summary: Chunk 1 of 3: constants, records (Intent, IntentEvent), schema, and docstring claims.
risks: SCHEMA_VERSION | low | Schema version is hardcoded but no migration logic is present in this chunk; if migration is missing, old databases may not be upgraded. Check _migrate_columns function in later chunk.
DEFAULT_DB_PATH | low | Default path is relative to ROOT; if ROOT is not correct at runtime, database may be created in unexpected location. Verify ROOT resolves correctly.
_uri_path | low | Windows path escaping may be incomplete if other special characters (e.g., % itself) are not encoded. Check if % is escaped.

to_statement | medium | Claims to use stored payload_sha, not recomputed; if payload_sha is ever wrong, the statement will contain an incorrect digest. Ensure payload_sha is always computed correctly on insert.
SCHEMA | medium | Schema creates tables and indexes but no foreign key enforcement is shown; foreign_keys=ON is set in connection? Not in this chunk. Check connection pragma.
trace_id nullable | low | Docstring says NULL is honest for no trace; but partial index excludes NULL, so untraced rows are not indexed. That is intentional but may affect query performance.
todos: Verify that _migrate_columns function exists in later chunk to handle v1 to v2 migration.
Check that foreign_keys pragma is set when connection is opened.
Confirm that _uri_path escapes percent signs and other reserved characters properly.
Ensure that payload_sha is computed consistently with canonical_sha before insert.

claims.text: record_intent writes an INTENDED row and COMMITS IT BEFORE the caller performs the external effect.
claims.why: record_intent function is not present in this chunk.

claims.text: the ledger can never be BEHIND reality: every effect that happened has a row.
claims.why: Depends on record_intent implementation and commit ordering, not in this chunk.

claims.text: The ledger CAN be ahead of reality: a crash after the effect lands and before mark_completed commits leaves an INTENDED row whose effect already happened.
claims.why: mark_completed not present; correctness depends on its implementation.

claims.text: resolve_by_effect is the ledger half of that handshake -- given a key found in the world, which intent claimed it.
claims.why: resolve_by_effect function not present in this chunk.

claims.text: intents rows are written once and never UPDATEd
claims.why: Schema shows CREATE TABLE without any UPDATE statements; events table is used for transitions.

claims.text: Every state transition APPENDS a row to intent_events; the current state is derived from the latest event
claims.why: Schema includes intent_events table with state column; no UPDATE on intents.

claims.text: mark_completed / mark_failed on an already-terminal intent raise IntentAlreadyResolved.
claims.why: mark_completed and mark_failed functions not present in this chunk.

claims.text: The check runs inside the same BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction as the append, so it cannot be raced.
claims.why: Transaction handling not visible in this chunk.

claims.text: journal_mode=WAL (readers never block the writer, and a committed row survives process death without a clean close)
claims.why: No connection pragma setting code in this chunk.

claims.text: synchronous=NORMAL (WAL's documented safe pairing: durable across process crash, which is the failure this module exists for; a power cut can lose the last commits)
claims.why: No connection pragma setting code in this chunk.

claims.text: busy_timeout (every write is BEGIN IMMEDIATE, which DOES honour the busy handler, so a second writer waits instead of erroring)
claims.why: No connection pragma or busy timeout setting code in this chunk.

claims.text: foreign_keys=ON (an event can never reference a vanished intent).
claims.why: No connection pragma setting code in this chunk.

claims.text: canonical_json/canonical_sha MOVED to envelope.py and are imported back here. The definition is unchanged and both names are still re-exported from this module (and from daedalus.spine), so every existing import path resolves.
claims.why: Cannot verify that envelope.py defines these names or that re-export works without seeing envelope.py or daedalus.spine __init__.py.

claims.text: v2 added the nullable intents.trace_id column. The bump is recorded in spine_meta but nothing GATES on it: a v1 database is migrated in place and a v1 row (trace_id NULL) stays readable forever, which is the whole backward compatibility contract. See _migrate_columns.
claims.why: _migrate_columns function not present; schema shows trace_id as nullable, but migration logic not in this chunk.

claims.text: open_intents scans for the ABSENCE of a terminal event; index the states that can end a life so that probe stays a lookup.
claims.why: Partial index idx_intent_events_terminal is defined with WHERE state IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED'), enabling efficient lookup for absence of terminal events.

claims.text: The subject digest is the STORED payload_sha, not a recomputation: re-hashing here would silently repair the one disagreement worth surfacing -- a stored digest that no longer matches its stored payload.
claims.why: to_statement uses self.payload_sha directly, not recomputed.

claims.text: DAEDALUS_SPINE_DB overrides it (tests and isolated worktrees point this away from the real runs/ directory).
claims.why: Function checks os.environ.get('DAEDALUS_SPINE_DB') and uses it if set.

claims.text: PROCESS-GLOBAL by design -- the counterpart, and deliberately NOT the same question, is daedalus.spine.picker.resolve_spine_db_path, which is repo-confined and ignores this env var so that picking for a foreign repository can never be redirected by inherited environment.
claims.why: Cannot verify behavior of resolve_spine_db_path without seeing that function.

claims.text: trace_id is NULLABLE and always will be.
claims.why: Schema defines trace_id TEXT without NOT NULL constraint.

observations.what: Docstring claims about record_intent, mark_completed, mark_failed, resolve_by_effect, and durability settings are uncheckable because those functions are not in this chunk.
SCHEMA_VERSION is 2 but no migration logic is present; relies on _migrate_columns in later chunk.
default_db_path uses Path(env) if env is non-empty; if DAEDALUS_SPINE_DB is set to an invalid path, errors may occur later.
_uri_path escapes backslash, ?, # but not percent sign; if path contains '%', it may be misinterpreted.
Intent.to_statement uses stored payload_sha; if payload_sha is ever incorrect, the statement will be invalid. No validation is present in this chunk.
Schema includes foreign key constraint on intent_events.intent_id but no explicit foreign_keys=ON pragma is set in this chunk.
